name: PakkuVr
summary: Immerse yourself in PakkuVR, the classic 80's game reinvented for the virtual reality era. In this thrilling first-person version, you'll find yourself devouring dots and dodging ghosts in three-dimensional mazes. Feel the adrenaline as you race against time and uncover hidden secrets in each level. With immersive graphics and gameplay that keeps you on the edge of your seat, PakkuVR offers the ultimate experience for fans of retro games and modern technology. Are you ready for the most immersive adventure
